duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ابْسُطْ لَنَا رِزْقَكَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, spread for us Your provision and enrich us with Your bounty.
O Allah, make me among the pious believers.
Our Lord, grant us goodness in this world.
Our Lord, forgive our sins.
O Allah, steady our footsteps.
O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge.
My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer.
O Allah, grant me the understanding of the Prophets.
My Lord, expand for me my breast.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، اجْعَلْ قَلْبِي نَاجِحًا
duas.english: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, make my heart succeed.
My Lord, enable me to thank Your favor.
O Allah, grant me understanding filled with wisdom.
My Lord, pour patience upon me.
O Allah, guide me to excellence.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الصَّلَاةَ نُورًا لِي فِي لَيْلِي وَنَهَارِي
duas.english: O Allah, make prayer a light for me in my day and night.
My Lord, increase me in reliance upon You.
My God, forgive me and have mercy on me.
O Allah, gather me with the righteous.
My Lord, make me of those who do good.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أُحَافِظَ عَلَى أَدَبِ الْإِسْلَامِ
duas.english: My Lord, grant me to uphold the manners of Islam.
O Allah, enable me to continually obey You.
My Lord, correct the end of my affairs.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِلْهَمْنِي الْهُدَى فِي كُلِّ قَرَارٍ
duas.english: O Allah, inspire me with guidance in every decision.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْأُمَمِ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُحَافِظِينَ عَلَى الْوَصْلِ
duas.english: O Lord of the nations, make me among those who maintain connection.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ احْفَظْنِي وَأَصْلَحْ لَنِي أُمُورَ الْحَيَاةِ
duas.english: My Lord, protect me and set right my worldly matters.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْبِبْ إِلَيَّ مَا تُحِبُّ وَأَحِبَّنِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ
duas.english: O Allah, make what You love beloved to me and make me beloved in what You love.
O Allah, carry me to eternal happiness.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي لِذِكْرِكَ مُخْبِرًا فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ
duas.english: My Lord, make me a reminder of You in every moment.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصِّلْ لِي السَّبِيلَ الْمُمَكِّنَ فِي جَمِيعِ الْخُطُوَاتِ
duas.english: O Allah, clarify for me the enabling path in every step.
